title: Pigeon Rush
brief: Drag a pigeon up and down across six lanes of two-way city traffic to peck crumbs that appear on alternating sidewalks. Eat 8 crumbs to win; three hits by cars or buses and you are flattened.

title: Pot Drop
brief: Steer a mouse with the joystick around a kitchen floor while glowing rings mark where pots will slam down, and knives later skid across. Survive the 50-second dinner rush (cheese heals) or lose all three lives.

title: Log Hop
brief: Drag a squirrel along the forest floor and tap JUMP to clear logs rolling in from both sides while pinecones rain from the canopy. Last until the clock reaches 60 to win; three hits and you are bonked.

title: Flare Grid
brief: Drag a solar probe around a square of space while the sun telegraphs full-width and full-height flare beams, and in the last storm aims crossed beams right at you. Survive four flare storms to win; three burns and the probe is vaporised.

title: Dodgeball Court
brief: Drag your player around your half of the gym while the other team winds up and hurls bouncing balls over the centre line, with a captain firing fastballs in the final round. Outlast three 20-second rounds to become champions; lose four lives and you are out.

title: Feedback Hunt
brief: Drag the singer around a dark stage while the corner speakers release homing feedback squeals that fizzle out after a few seconds; duck behind the solid amp stacks to block them. Keep singing until the volume reaches 10 for an encore, or get drowned out after three hits.

title: Spider Drop
brief: Slide a fire ant left and right along the garden floor while spiders drop from a branch to random depths and climb back up, and dew drops pelt down in the last wave. Survive three waves to get home before dark; three bites and you are wrapped in silk.

title: Press Line
brief: Slide a factory robot along a conveyor belt that keeps dragging it sideways while five hydraulic presses glow red and slam down at random. Last until the presses stamp 60 parts to finish the shift; three crushes (or falling sparks late in the shift) end it.

title: Lava Tiles
brief: Drag a hiker across a crater floor of 20 basalt tiles; random tiles glow orange, then erupt into lava twice, more of them as the heat climbs, and fire wisps start patrolling at heat 4. Survive 60 seconds (blue springs heal) or melt after three burns.

title: Bounce House
brief: Steer a spark with the joystick around a neon room while a cannon adds one more wall-bouncing ball every five seconds; grab the occasional record to slow them all down. Survive ten beats to win; two hits and you pop.

title: Pin Dodge
brief: You are the last bowling pin: tap the LEFT, MIDDLE or RIGHT lane pad to hop lanes as straight balls, two-ball splits and diagonal hook balls roll down at you. Stay standing for ten frames to bowl a perfect game; three hits knock you down.

title: Storm Eye
brief: Drag a seagull to stay inside the calm eye of a hurricane: the storm walls flash and then close in twice while shingles and branches blow across, and touching a wall throws you back to the centre. Hold on until the storm calms and passes; three hits and you are swept away.

title: Searchlight Yard
brief: Steer a raccoon with the joystick around a night-time scrapyard, grabbing snacks while three searchlights sweep their routes; each time a light catches you, a guard dog is let out to chase you for a few seconds, and crates block it. Eat 12 snacks to win; lose four lives and you are caught.

title: Sprinkler Lawn
brief: Steer a water-hating cat with the joystick across three gardens to the porch while turning sprinklers sweep jets of water around like clock hands, and a robot mower patrols the last lawn. Reach the porch of the third garden to win; four soakings (with a second of safety after each) and the cat gives up.

title: Shark Dash
brief: Drag a minnow up and down at the left edge of the sea while sharks creep out of the reef, turn red and then dash straight across their lane. Let 30 sharks dash past to outswim the pack; three bites and you are a snack.
